# Artifact Templates

| Template | Owner |
|---|---|
| `manifest.yaml`, `status.md` | `paco-ticket` |
| `requirements.md` | `paco-requirements` |
| `feature-location.md`, `exploration.md` | `paco-explore` |
| `test-cases.md` | `paco-test-design` |
| `automation.md` | `paco-playwright` |
| `report.md`, `defect.md`, `open-question.md` | `paco-report` |

Markdown templates end with `## Tester notes`. Skill updates preserve that final section byte-for-byte or stop on conflict.

Placeholders describe required shape only. Do not convert unknown ticket/product facts into expected behavior.
